final_acceptance_rule: Every slot required by the accepted SCRV3 contract must resolve exactly and consistently with SCRV2APP; any missing, conflicting, stale, hash-mismatched, ambiguous, or widened binding fails final M6 closed.
must_not_bind_from: active SCRV3 branch name or unaccepted candidate artifact alone
ADP-017 precedent alone when SCRV3 final contract could wrap/bind it differently
mutable latest authority or semantic version precedence
PSEPF or any other upstream prior
purpose: Exact values final M6 must bind only from an accepted SCRV3 return. This preflight intentionally does not invent or promote active-branch candidate literals.
